resources.string: The virtual gamepad needs shell access, which this app gets by pairing with your device\'s own wireless debugging. Tap below, then choose \"Pair device with pairing code\" and type the code into the notification that appears.
Pairing needs notification permission — the code has to be typed into a notification, because opening this app closes the pairing dialog.
Wireless debugging needs Android 11 or newer, so the virtual gamepad and emulator setup aren\'t available on this device. Motion output over DSU still works.
The pairing window closed. Re-open \"Pair device with pairing code\" and try again.
Pairing failed. Check the six-digit code and try again.
Paired, but the connection failed. Check that wireless debugging is still on.
Not paired with this device yet. Tap \"Pair device\" to set it up.
No privileged access — pair with wireless debugging first.
Failed to create the virtual gamepad — check privileged access.
